title: Gas and Power at One Site: Add-On to the Small Business Electricity Supply Multi-Site Credit
content:
When a site supplied under Small Business Electricity Supply also takes Beacon Ridge commercial gas, the site's multi-site credit carries a same-site gas add-on. When the site also takes Beacon Ridge commercial gas under an active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on a plan with a fixed term, the multi-site credit adds 2.40 dollars; when the site's active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement is on the month-to-month index plan, it adds 1.00 dollar; when the site has no active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement, it adds nothing.

## Questions answered

**Which gas record decides the add-on?**
The Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the same site as the electricity agreement: its status and the term of its plan.

| Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the same site | Same-site gas add-on |
|---|---|
| active, on a plan with a fixed term (a term above 0 months) | 2.40 USD |
| active, on the month-to-month index plan | 1.00 USD |
| no active one at the site | none |

**The business has a gas agreement, but at another of its sites. Does the electricity site take the add-on?**
No. The add-on reads the gas agreement at the electricity agreement's own site; with no active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement at that site, it adds nothing.

**The site's gas agreement is still enrollment pending, or has been closed.**
Neither is an active agreement, so the site has no active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement and the add-on adds nothing.

**Hypothetical pair of sites of one business.** Site A has an active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on a 24-month fixed plan: 2.40 USD. Site B has an active gas agreement on the month-to-month index plan: 1.00 USD.
